hero.title: The power path, from source to site.
hero.lede: EnerYetu connects international suppliers of parts, machinery, consumables and skilled manpower with the Angolan sites that need them — and installs and maintains the solar, wind, storage and off-grid systems that keep them running.

diagram.caption: Typical reference line — every site differs

rows.label: Supply, install and maintain in one contract

intro.title: A bridge between international supply and Angolan site work.
intro.body: We are the Angolan arm of international manufacturers and suppliers, handling everything from a single spare part to a full off-grid plant: procurement, logistics, installation and after-sales service.

services.title: Instrumentation of the offer
services.body: Eight service lines, one partner — engineered for plants and sites that cannot afford downtime.

items.title: Technical service
items.blurb: Planned and corrective maintenance, in the field and in the workshop, for equipment that must not stop.

items.title: Solar energy
items.blurb: Design and installation of photovoltaic systems, grid-tied and stand-alone.

items.title: Panels & modules
items.blurb: Supply and installation of panels and modules at the right specification for your yield.

items.title: Wind generation
items.blurb: Wind turbines for hybrid and rural power, sized to your wind profile.

items.title: Energy storage
items.blurb: Battery banks and battery-management integrations for solar and backup power.

items.title: Off-grid solutions
items.blurb: Complete stand-alone power for sites beyond the grid — from mini-grids to single loads.

items.title: Upgrades & expansions
items.blurb: Capacity additions and modernisation of existing plants, with the least possible downtime.

items.title: Hydropower plants
items.blurb: Small hydro through supply, installation and service.

beyond.title: One contract, the whole scope
beyond.body: Most projects need more than an installation crew. We scope the complete picture so you deal with a single local partner.

items.title: Supply
items.blurb: Spare parts, consumables and machinery sourced from verified international manufacturers.

items.title: Manpower
items.blurb: Skilled technicians and workers seconded to your project or operation.

items.title: After-sales
items.blurb: Maintenance contracts and technical support after commissioning.

sectors.title: Where we work
sectors.body: Energy needs differ by industry. We know the equipment, the standards and the uptime each one demands.

items.title: Oil & gas
items.blurb: Power and equipment for onshore operations and support facilities.

items.title: Mining & resources
items.blurb: Plant power, standby systems and parts supply for site crews.

items.title: Telecom
items.blurb: Rural site power and backup for towers, exchanges and data shelters.

items.title: Agribusiness
items.blurb: Cold-chain and irrigation power for farms, processors and storage.

items.title: Public infrastructure
items.blurb: Electrification for health, education and public buildings.

items.title: Industrial & commercial
items.blurb: Solar, storage and maintenance for factories and commercial buildings.

training.title: Skills that stay on site.
training.body: Hands-on technical training for technicians and operators — so the people who maintain your plant actually mastered it.

partners.title: Working with international suppliers
partners.body: We carry a verified catalogue of parts, machinery and consumables from manufactured partnerships we can prove.

cta.title: Have a site to power, or a plant to keep running?
cta.body: Tell us the requirement — we will scope the supply, the installation and the people.

about.title: The Angolan partner for energy supply and delivery.
about.lead: We are the Angolan partner for building bridges with international suppliers — solving the call for parts, equipment, machinery, consumables and skilled manpower.
about.body1: We work as the local arm of international manufacturers: procurement, logistics, installation and after-sales service for energy and industrial equipment across Angola.
about.body2: Our engineers and technicians keep plants running and bring electricity to sites that do not have it — solar, wind, storage and off-grid alike.

values.title: Sustainable vision
values.blurb: Plants built to be maintained for decades.

values.title: Driven by results
values.blurb: Commissioned on time, or we say why.

values.title: Reliable support
values.blurb: A phone number that answers after the handover.

careers.title: Build Angolan energy with us.
careers.body: We hire technicians, engineers and safety staff who like their work measured in uptime. If that is you, tell us.

positions.title: Field service technician
positions.blurb: Maintain solar, storage and generation systems at client sites across the country.

positions.title: Electrical engineer
positions.blurb: Scope, design and commission installations, from load audits to handover.

positions.title: HSE officer
positions.blurb: Own site safety, audits and the delivery of our HSE training.
